Subject: Vendor setup: procurement checklist, DPA & SOC2 links

Hi Naomi,

We're moving Cartique onto your platform and procurement has asked me to collect the required privacy/security artifacts so we can open a PO. Can you please provide the following:

- Executable DPA (PDF or DocuSign link)
- Latest SOC 2 report (or a link to where we can download it)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred)
- Any required supplier intake form or vendor questionnaire we should complete

Additionally, please confirm your standard PO terms (billing contact, invoice remit address, and net terms). Our finance team needs those to create the PO and route for approval.

I've attached our supplier intake form (PDF) — feel free to flag any questions. We'd like to complete setup by next week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Moreno
Vendor Operations | Cartique Ltd
procurement@cartique.com
+1 415-555-0124

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the intake form. Welcome (and excited to have Cartique onboard). Below are the items and next steps to get the PO processed quickly: 

1) DPA: attaching the current DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf_stub). We usually execute via DocuSign; if you prefer an uploaded signed copy, we can provide that after both parties sign.

2) SOC 2: public download link to the most recent report: https://drive.google.com/redwood-soc2-2028-report

3) Subprocessor list: attaching the live CSV snapshot (redwood_subprocessors_2028-07.csv). If you need vendor-specific risk details for any entry, ping Karthik and he can pull the risk summary.

4) PO & billing: Our finance team requires PO number before we can raise an invoice. Standard remit: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, billing@redwood.ai. Net 30 by default unless you need a different terms schedule (we can discuss for enterprise deals). For AP contact: ap@redwood.ai, and the legal entity is Redwood Inference, Inc.

Action items for Cartique to finish onboarding:
- Confirm whether you want DocuSign for the DPA or a signed PDF back-and-forth
- Provide PO number and bill-to contact + billing email
- Return completed supplier intake form (I attached a redline in-line where we prefer fields populated)

I've looped in Ben (sales) for invoicing/pricing questions and Karthik (legal) to handle any DPA redlines or subprocessor follow-ups. If you want, we can schedule a 20-min sync this week to hand off everything to your finance/procurement team.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Procurement & Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Hi Elena — quick note from the billing side.

Thanks for sending the intake file. Once we have the PO number from Cartique our AP team will:
- Generate the invoice referencing the PO
- Send invoices to billing@cartique.com (or the AP contact you provide)
- Standard payment timing: Net 30 (we can accommodate Net 45 for larger enterprise agreements; flag if required)

DocuSign: Naomi mentioned a DocuSign flow for the DPA. If you prefer that, here is a one-click link to the DPA envelope we prepared: https://www.docusign.com/naomi/redwood-dpa-2028. Signing there will speed routing on both sides.

HubSpot deal for tracking: HC-45271 — I added Cartique as the onboarding milestone and set a reminder to chase PO by Aug 3.

If any of your stakeholders (legal or security) want to review the subprocessor CSV, Karthik can run through the items and provide a short risk note.

Short checklist to close:
- Cartique provides PO number and AP billing contact
- DPA signed (DocuSign or emailed PDF)
- Intake form returned — then we flip Live for provisioning

Happy to jump on a call to expedite.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
